definitions.explanation: the process of having experts in a field evaluate academic or scientific papers before publication

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}が{査読|さどく}を{通|とお}った。
{査読|さどく}{付|つ}き{雑誌|ざっし}に{論文|ろんぶん}を{投稿|とうこう}した。
examples.english: I submitted a paper to a peer-reviewed journal.

examples.japanese: {査読|さどく}{者|しゃ}から{修正|しゅうせい}の{依頼|いらい}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: I received revision requests from the reviewers.

notes:
FORMATION:
{査|さ} (inspect, examine) + {読|どく} (read) → reading to examine

VERB FORM:
{査読|さどく}する (to peer review)

ACADEMIC TERMS:
- {査読|さどく}{者|しゃ} (peer reviewer)
- {査読|さどく}{付|つ}き{論文|ろんぶん} (peer-reviewed paper)
- {査読|さどく}{付|つ}き{雑誌|ざっし} (peer-reviewed journal)
- {査読|さどく}{過程|かてい} (peer review process)

PROCESS:
{投稿|とうこう} (submission) → {査読|さどく} (peer review) → {採用|さいよう}/{不採用|ふさいよう} (acceptance/rejection)

RELATED WORDS:
- {審査|しんさ} (examination, screening)
- {校閲|こうえつ} (proofreading)
